svg.title: Thus |fξ(p)| ≥(c/2)wξ. Its reciprocal is holomorphic on this common cube and bounded by 2/(cwξ). The width r is independent of ξ. This is the required reciprocal estimate; real positivity alone would not prove complex nonvanishing. In particular, define λM(p) = X a [Mχ(pa/M)][Mχ(−pa/M)].
